meta.description: Global reference seed backlog for Achiote cache and reference hardening, including the first balanced pantry expansion

notes: Seeds are research targets only and must be converted into sourced ResearchRecord entries before factual use.
This starter set spans food and drink forms so no single category dominates the cache plan.
Expansion 1 adds one seed for each culture-area and food-memory band pair to reduce weak-model inference burden without claiming cultural completeness.
